name: In-flight Rest & EASA
features:
Agreed with the player (22 Oct): they supplied an authoritative EASA FTL reference guide (current Oct 2026) and asked to 'study it and apply it to the game; in-flight rest and the rest classes available on each plane must be a BIG thing; correct any parameters that might be wrong'. SOURCES (read both in full before designing): the guide /home/user/wt/notes/.handover/updates/EASA-guide-2026-10.txt (it is the authority; where it and anything else disagree, the guide wins) and the read-only audit of the v0.7.2 tree /home/user/wt/notes/.handover/updates/EASA-audit-v0.7.2.md (sections 0, A = every parameter MATCH/WRONG/MISSING with file:line, B = rest facilities per aircraft type with proposed shares/bunk counts and the data model, C = the visible in-flight rest feature, D = contradictions in the v0.7.2 docs, Appendix = order of work). Line numbers in the audit may have moved: re-locate before editing. Build ALL of this:

1. CORRECT EVERY WRONG PARAMETER AND CITATION (audit A + D + Appendix steps 1–2): fix EASA-FTL.md and code comments/citations (ED Decision 2014/002/R + 2023/023/R; Table 1/2/3/4 names; CS FTL.1.205(b)/(c) letters; ORO.FTL.215 positioning; etc.); drop the cabin rest table's extra 18:01–18:30 row (table ends at 17:31–18:00 = 3:50; cabin caps 18:00/17:00/16:00 by class 1/2/3); commander's discretion only for unforeseen circumstances at or after report (never offered for planned duties; +2 h, +3 h augmented in all texts; base = basic FDP; rest after ≥ 10 h); rest after ANY augmented FDP ≥ preceding duty or 14 h; consecutive night duties computed with at most 4 sectors; contract feasibility uses the real max FDP for the report time (not a flat 13 h) and the aircraft's rest classes. Keep EASA-FTL.md the single reference, rewritten to match the guide.

2. IN-FLIGHT REST AS A BIG, VISIBLE FEATURE (audit B + C, player's top priority):
   a. Separate PILOT and CABIN CREW rest facilities per airframe with class 1/2/3 and number of places (FCRC bunks, overhead CCRC, A330/A340 lower-deck module LDMCR, curtained business seats = class 2, crew rest recliners with leg rest = class 3; a plain economy row is NOT class 3). Realistic per-type shares and bunk counts from audit B2; market rolls them per airframe; save migration per audit B3 (old {bunks, seats} → new model; nothing an old save relies on becomes illegal).
   b. restPlan(): a deterministic per-duty in-flight rest plan (audit C2): cruise windows, pilots 90 consecutive min each and 120 for the landing pilots, max 3 sectors, 'cruise too short → no extension', cabin crew minimum rest from the CS FTL.1.205(c)(3) table by FDP band and cabin class, service constraints (half the cabin crew stay in the cabin, no rest in the first 90 / last 60 min), extra cabin crew when needed, seats blocked only on flights that need rest. pickAugment, complement(), feasibility and the bot all use it.
   c. Where the player sees it (audit C3): fleet card + market listing show 'Pilots rest: … · Cabin crew rest: …' and 'Longest day: 16 h with 3 pilots · 17 h with 4 (18 h on one long sector)'; market filter 'Has bunks'; a small static bunk glyph on the aircraft art where the compartment really is (no animation); flight sheet 'In-flight rest' section with a calm static timeline of who rests when, where and how long (pilots by name, cabin crew in groups), verdict chip and the blocked-seats line; duty modal 'Day length X of Y · Why Y?' explanation incl. the cabin crew band; offer modal per-aircraft line (✓ / needs 4th pilot / needs refit); roster board bed icon + 3P/4P on augmented duties.
   d. Plain-language cards (v0.7.1 four-line format) for restFacility, restTooShort, cabinRest, restSeats (audit C4) with one-tap fixes (swap aircraft, 4th pilot, more cabin crew, plan a refit) and glossary terms (class 1/2/3 rest, FCRC, CCRC, lower-deck crew rest module, in-flight rest, landing pilots, augmented crew).
   e. Refit options (audit C5): curtain off business seats (class 2), crew rest recliners (class 3, incl. A321LR/757), lower-deck crew rest module for A330/A340, flight crew rest compartment for 767/A330 (MRO, best combined with a C-check at the v0.7.2 hubs), overhead rest for big twins; each shows 'Opens: 16 h days with 3 pilots (was 15 h)'.
   f. Contracts: long-haul and ULR offers state the rest they need; ULR needs class 1 for both pilots and cabin crew; prices/feasibility/bot follow (audit C6).

3. THE MISSING RULES (audit Appendix 4–5, 7), each with tests, plain-language cards and rostering that respects them: planned extension +1 h (CS FTL.1.205(b) table incl. 3/4/5-sector columns and 'not allowed' cells, max 2× per 7 days per crew member, sector limits by WOCL encroachment, +2/+2 or +4 h rest, not with in-flight rest or split duty); delayed reporting (CS FTL.1.205(d) <4 h / ≥4 h / ≥10 h rules); disruptive schedules early/late type (pick one, documented) + late/night → early needs 1 local night + 4+ disruptive → 60 h recovery; 2 local days twice a month; time-zone compensation table CS FTL.1.235(b)(3)(i) and 3 local nights between alternating E/W rotations; away rest after ≥4 h zone difference ≥ duty or 14 h; split duty (CS FTL.1.220) and standby/reserve (CS FTL.1.225/230) as simplified-but-correct rules where the game uses them (at least: split duty available to the roster for long ground breaks; airport/home standby counting rules for the v0.7.1 call-in fix).

4. 'WHAT'S NEW' entry for v0.7.3 at the top of src/data/whatsNew.ts.
Keep: calm visuals, iPad landscape, real names, speeds 1/2/4 only, old saves load (migrations tested), bot in band (seeds 1–6), the rules readable by a former cabin crew member.

BASE: v0.7.2 Crew Rules & Fleet is released and in the tree (EASA-FTL.md, rules.ts tables, crewRest.ts {bunks, seats} model, rest-seat refit, PUR/CC, captain-as-FO, C-check MRO hubs in data/mro.ts, sale/early return, ops strip, compact Up Next) on top of v0.7.1 Crew Control (Crew Control panel, private jets, plain-language cards/<Term> glossary/WHY? buttons/gauges/timelines). The audit was made against the v0.7.2 tree before its last fixes; re-check each item. Optional v0.7.2 leftovers to fold in if cheap: WHY? dot text 12 px on touch; bottom padding on fleet/crew lists under the home indicator; the bot sub-charters too much on seed 2 (prefer cancel/reshuffle before sub-chartering long series).
